reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Patient-paired multiomic treatment-associated program discovery, assay-specific preprocessing, primary late integration/enrichment and locked external cohort validation.

checks.quote: # Analysis Design: Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omic Program from Paired Tumor Samples
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult original assay Methods, supplements or validated analysis protocols and check their transfer to the present inputs.

checks.quote: change attributable to treatment
checks.reason: An uncontrolled pre/post contrast is not attributable to treatment alone; time, concurrent care and progression remain alternatives even with patient pairing.

checks.quote: Batch-effect audit
checks.reason: The ordered workflow applies ComBat before specifying scale/normalization, then offers transformed RNA followed by count-model alternatives without an explicit raw-count versus transformed-input branch. Executable input requirements are unresolved.

checks.quote: Average the standardised per-omic scores
checks.reason: No explicit sign orientation and missing-component/coverage denominator make the composite comparable across patients/cohorts. A one-sided positive test is not justified for potentially negative component scores without orientation.

checks.quote: If fewer, power is insufficient
checks.reason: The 20-pair cutoff is asserted without a program-level effect/variance/precision calculation. A generic single-feature t-test power statement does not justify the selected multi-pathway or external inference.

checks.quote: Fisher's or Stouffer's method
checks.reason: RNA/protein/metabolite pathway evidence from the same patients is dependent; ordinary p-value combinations need an explicit covariance-aware or valid dependence-preserving null calibration.

checks.quote: Little's test
checks.reason: A failure to reject MCAR does not establish MCAR or distinguish MAR from MNAR. The proposed binary classification therefore does not justify imputation eligibility. Cramer V alone also is not a design-rank/contrast-estimability test.

checks.quote: relax the per-omic FDR to 0.15
checks.reason: Thresholds are relaxed when too few features/pathways pass. Documenting result-driven relaxation does not provide an error-calibrated, locked parameter search.

checks.quote: # Analysis Design: Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omic Program from Paired Tumor Samples
checks.reason: A revised program after failure is not explicitly refrozen and assigned fresh independent confirmation.

checks.quote: retain only for post-hoc confirmation
checks.reason: Completely batch-confounded metabolomics cannot confirm an RNA/protein treatment signal. Supportive use cannot supply the missing counterfactual; this is a distinct invalid claim gate.

checks.quote: # Analysis Design: Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omic Program from Paired Tumor Samples
checks.reason: No immutable input manifest, stable file/sample provenance links, exact software/environment and execution commands.

checks.quote: re-run B–C
checks.reason: Resampling repeats differential/enrichment stages but not fitted preprocessing/imputation in A, allowing held-out patient information into internal stability evaluation.

checks.quote: permute pre/post labels within patients
checks.reason: Within-patient swaps do not preserve exchangeability when time is confounded with assay batch; preprocessing is also omitted from the permutation pipeline. No valid conditional null is supplied.

checks.quote: # Analysis Design: Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omic Program from Paired Tumor Samples
checks.reason: No clean-environment numerical rerun, declared output tolerances or resource/failure/source-difference logs.

checks.quote: # Analysis Design: Identifying a Reproducible Treatment-Associated Multi-Omic Program from Paired Tumor Samples
checks.reason: The plan is traceable to the packet and preserves a genuinely untouched external cohort, with useful technical QC and pathway-level outputs. Dependent evidence combination, adaptive threshold relaxation and supportive use of confounded metabolites substantially weaken its causal and statistical interpretation. Distinct defects are assigned to specific checks only.
